text: 美债空头“一边倒”，全球债市拉响警报 美国国债市场因通胀黏性、地缘冲突推升油价及财政供给压力三重因素共振，导致收益率创多年新高且空头仓位极度拥挤，引发市场对极端押注可能触发剧烈反向行情的警惕。
text_en: US Treasury bears are "one-sided," global bond markets sound the alarm. The US Treasury market is seeing yields hit multi-year highs and short positioning become extremely crowded amid the resonance of three factors—sticky inflation, geopolitical conflicts pushing up oil prices, and fiscal supply pressure—raising market vigilance that extreme bets could trigger a violent reversal.
